mentions.name: AveryIQ
mentions.description: A modern, fully-fledged property management system for rental properties that acts as an extension of the owner's communication channels, handling email, SMS, and voice calls. It automates routine tenant interactions so a moderately-sized long-term rental portfolio can run itself, texting the owner weekly only for important decisions such as work order vendor bid approvals and lease signatures.
mentions.problem: Existing property management tools like Appfolio, TurboTenant, and Innago are just an extra chore that don't actually help do the work, and the author was tired of repeatedly answering the same property management questions for their rental properties.
mentions.audience: Landlords and rental property owners managing long-term rental portfolios
mentions.source_excerpt: I got sick of answering the same property management questions over and over again for my rental properties, and am finally building a modern, fully-fledged property management system, AveryIQ - https://averyiq.com
